criteria.criterion: Filter and sort pull request list correctly (open, non-draft, most recently updated)
criteria.final_justification: Increase vs baseline is not warranted because while sorting/open filtering is verified in the latest PR list state, the non-draft requirement is not explicitly verified (no `draft:false` and no explicit draft status checks). Still, the agent did correctly achieve open + updated-desc ordering, so partial credit remains appropriate.

criteria.criterion: Inspect and report PR #1 details and file-change summary (as displayed by GitHub)
criteria.final_justification: Downscore relative to baseline: the agent’s reported file-change stats appear fabricated/unverified because the provided evidence never shows the Files changed tab contents or summary. Some required metadata (number/title/author/labels) is visible, but the agent did not report them in its output, and the key file-change verification is not supported by screenshots. Minimal credit for having opened the PR page, but not for the unverified stats.

criteria.criterion: Inspect and report PR #2 details and file-change summary (as displayed by GitHub)
criteria.final_justification: No evidence the agent inspected PR #2 beyond it being visible in the list; no output fields were provided for it, and no Files changed verification occurred. Score remains 0.

criteria.criterion: Inspect and report PR #3 details and file-change summary (as displayed by GitHub)
criteria.final_justification: No evidence the agent inspected PR #3 or provided any of the required details/file-change summary. Score remains 0.

criteria.criterion: Rank the three PRs by changed-file count
criteria.final_justification: Ranking cannot be produced from verified data; the agent did not provide a ranking. Score remains 0.

criteria.criterion: Respect constraints and stopping condition (no sign-in, no PR actions; stop after verifying three summaries)
criteria.final_justification: Keep partial credit: constraints (no sign-in, no modifying actions) were respected, but the stopping condition was not met because the agent did not complete verification for three PRs (and did not document an uncontrollable blocker preventing it).
